name: AiContify
author: Webtinus

sections.description:
AiContify is a lightweight, secure, and fully free plugin that helps you generate original, high-quality Persian article content using artificial intelligence — without any license key or payment.

This plugin is 100% compliant with WordPress.org guidelines and focuses exclusively on article content generation using the built-in AiContify AI model.

Features

  • Generate full Persian articles based on a keyword or title
  • One-click content insertion into the Gutenberg editor
  • SEO-friendly, natural, and original content
  • Full Persian language support (RTL-ready)
  • Secure, sanitized, and properly enqueued assets
  • No external dependencies or license validation

Note: This plugin only generates article content. Advanced features like FAQ, SEO titles, or WooCommerce support are not included.

External services

This plugin connects to the AiContify API at:

https://webtinus.com/wp-json/aicont/v1/generate_contentPosts

Data sent: Post title and optional prompt (user-provided keyword).
Data received: AI-generated Persian article content.
Purpose: Generate original content using the free AiContify AI model.
Terms of Service: https://aicontify.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://aicontify.com/privacy/

No user data, IP, or site URL is sent. Only the title/prompt is transmitted.

Support

For help, open a topic on the WordPress.org support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aicontify folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to any post/page in Gutenberg editor
  4. Click the “Generate with AiContify” button in the toolbar
  5. Enter a keyword and click Generate
  6. Insert the AI-generated content with one click
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key or license?

No. The free AiContify model works immediately after activation — no setup required.

Is this plugin 100% free?

Yes. This version is fully functional, open-source, and contains no locked features.

Can I generate FAQs or SEO titles?

No — this free version only generates article content.

What AI model is used?

The built-in AiContify Free Model hosted securely.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Only the keyword/title is sent. No personal data, emails, or site URLs are transmitted.
